title: MH$
description: This Paper plugin adds a currency that controls your health
body:
MH$
===
*By MinePokemine*

This Spigot/Paper plugin adds a currency called MH$ to Minecraft. It works like any other currency. You can use it with any mods that work with currency.

It's not a normal currency, though. Each MH\$1,000 (or whatever you change it to in the configs) you have is a heart you have. When one player kills another, the killer get MH\$1000 (again configurable), and the victim loses the same amount.

Dependenies
-----------

- Vault Unlocked (<https://modrinth.com/plugin/vaultunlocked>)
